content: Chromium components/input/web_input_event_builders_mac.mm maps NSEventSubtypeTabletPoint to force=[event pressure], tilt_x=tilt.x*90, tilt_y=(isFlipped?1:-1)*tilt.y*90, tangential_pressure, twist=(int)[event rotation]; pointer type pen via tablet proximity. Wacom macOS 26.0-26.2 had a click bug fixed in macOS 26.3 and driver 6.4.13; historic Chromium m60 regression fixed in m61.
